_about: Human judgement calls used by scripts/readme_results.py, written down so they are reviewable. Each key is <run>/<scenario> or <run>/containment/<index>.

exclude_mttd.live8/contain_udp_flood: the SYN flood's 300 s port rule was still active when this flood started, so it never reached the victim; it was detected ~1.5 s after the rule expired

exclude_mttc.live9/containment/1: a second, identical port drop approved 3 s after the first; the victim was already being contained, so it is not an independent MTTC

lost_runs.live6: the bridge exited because the server was not up; nothing reached the website (fixed in v5.4.0: the bridge now waits)
